hero.title: Hey, I'm Ashwin
hero.tagline: Full Stack Web Developer crafting functional, fun & intuitive web experiences

bio.professional:
I'm Ashwin Kumar, a full-stack MERN developer from Pune, India.

I've got about a year of professional experience building web applications, and while I handle both frontend and backend, I'm definitely more drawn to the frontend — turning designs into smooth, responsive interfaces that actually feel good to use. That said, I'm comfortable across the stack: setting up APIs, working with databases, structuring servers, and making sure everything connects cleanly.

I like building things that are intuitive and fast without unnecessary complexity. Whether it's polishing UI interactions, improving performance, or quickly prototyping in Figma, I enjoy the parts where code meets user experience the most.
bio.personal:
Outside of code, I'm usually:

• Listening to music or watching movies
• Playing games
• Taking photos (still learning how to tell better stories through the lens)
• Occasionally messing around in Blender or game dev experiments

Anything with a creative spark tends to catch my attention. I'm constantly exploring new tools and trying to get a little better at the things I care about.

philosophy.title: How I Approach Building
philosophy.quote: The fastest way to learn is to build something real — then break it, fix it, and make it better. Every project is part playground, part craft, and part stubborn problem-solving.
philosophy.extra: I believe good software should feel effortless to use while being solid under the hood. Simplicity + reliability > flashy complexity.
